test_method: Deterministic unit tests with stubbed understander, policy and tools, followed by synthetic production-path integration tests. No V4 fixture, case ID, near-paraphrase or expected-action lookup. Assert state transitions, candidate sets, selected actions, result provenance and answer-context audit.
